column1: # Phantom-path corpus: the [sim-fixture] trap dumps from the 7-hour bot run
# (logs/bot_run.log, blocks 26335759..26335910) reduced to the paths the rig
# reproduces, plus the degenerate dead-token legs the solver must never
# fabricate margin on.
# Every row's pool state is rebuilt FROM CHAIN READS at `anchor_block` (V2
# reserves word, V3 slot0/liquidity + the full swap-direction tick map, V4
# PoolManager slots) — the divergence probe's 0-finding licenses chain state
# as the engine's state.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   path_id  anchor_block  hop_index  kind  pool  token0  token1  fee  tick_spacing  zfo  dex
#   kind        V2 | V3 | V4
#   pool        pair/pool address (V2, V3) or the PoolManager (V4)
#   tick_spacing  V4: required (part of the pool key). V3: empty = read
#                 `tickSpacing()` from the pool.
#   dex         V2 only: the canonical router that must serve the leg.
#   zfo         token0 -> token1 when True.
# Source rows below are copied verbatim from the trap dump except:
#   * path 73502 comes from the investigation's earlier run (the PM-verified
#     1bp USDC/DAI/WETH triangle) and is pinned to this run's anchor block;
#   * the `leg-ren-*` rows are single-hop leg tests for the dead REN pools
#     (liquidity 0; two pinned at MIN_TICK) — the degenerate class.
